subject: Exclusive Offer Inside: Save 20% on Your Next Purchase!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive discount of 20% on your next purchase with us. Simply use the code SAVE20 at checkout to avail this special offer. Hurry, this offer is valid for a limited time only. Don't miss out on the chance to save on your favorite products. Thank you for being a loyal customer. Happy shopping!
